_comment: Bench preset around the shop at 50 Day St, Norwalk (box cut around nearby 165 Water St; covers both). course_shop.jpg is local-only (license).
source: SkyFi order 26378IFJ-3, Vantor satellite image 2026-10-12 15:32Z (SUPER_HIGH), delivered as a non-georeferenced PNG; georeferenced by affine registration (ECC) against the CT ECO 2023 ortho on 2026-11-05 (rotation -10.81 deg, ~0.367 m/px), warped north-up onto a box around 165 Water St / 50 Day St (extrapolated ~2 km from the registration area; expect a few metres of error) at 0.34 m/px.
